title: Compare staging and production
brief: One environment's shop release is failing while the other is healthy. Compare both Applications before changing the affected one.

checks.question: Which Application is failing?
checks.hint: Compare the two environment labels and health badges.
checks.why: The Applications list identifies the affected environment.

checks.question: What readiness path is configured only in the failing environment?
checks.hint: Compare the Desired manifests of the two Deployments.
checks.why: The desired manifest identifies environment-specific drift.

truth.cause: One environment's readiness probe uses a path that does not exist
truth.fix: Restore the affected environment's probe path in git
